properties.name: The v0.21.0 version bump. The design meaning of a cut lives in the Release and the epoch, not in a version string — the declaration itself (what this design depends on, and at which version of it) is unchanged: dynograph-foundation stays pinned at v0.12.0. Expected on every cut; the release manifest's frozen as_checksum for this artifact is updated in the same pass, since the INCLUDES edge was written from the pre-bump value.
